scope: Editable whole-pose native Blender authoring with original licensed rig, rifle and runtime viewmodel camera. Finite visually authored postures, not contact-point numerical fitting.
source_policy: Retain all original4103 vertices,8152 triangles,50 bones,UVs,weights,rest matrices and bone parents exactly. Preserve20 original constraints with mute=true for independent native pose editing. No destructive edit-mode roundtrip, reparenting, normalization or loose-vertex cleanup in the authoring master.
coordinates: Original source world including Zpi; T(body_origin) Rx(-pi/2) S(.09). Rifle remains Y-up,-Z forward. Presentation root separately uses runtime scale .62, hip/ADS offsets and Three Euler XYZ reload rotation. No exporter-axis compensation in saved scene.
camera: 58 degree vertical perspective,near .01,far10,1440x900. Assert Blender projection against a tested runtime projection. Hip/ADS/reload-lowered root placements are keyed markers, not a reload animation or complete camera-envelope approval.
surface_regions: Use reviewed v14 original first-web cleft seed3392/3393/3394/3417, rifle upper rear1686/1687/1714/1715 and opposite42-face scope. Single prior pixel/bary points are not mandatory targets. Overlay collection is diagnostic and excluded from render/runtime.
appearance: Original licensed skin texture is diagnostic only. Tactical sleeves/gloves require source provenance and independent review before runtime use.
gates: source hashes and exact original topology/weights/UV/rest/hierarchy
native fixed bone lengths and connected wrist/elbow endpoints
anatomical contact and full hand/weapon/self-intersection clearance
runtime resource and sustained gameplay budgets
not_completion: A usable native authoring scene and passing camera tests do not approve the pose or establish CS2-quality gameplay. Rejected study images and source must remain evidence outside runtime.

optical_candidate.status: single static optical view only; no arm/animation/runtime acceptance
optical_candidate.source_points: Rear component42 circle center; front component59 top four vertices mean; named original FBX ownership verified.

proportion_calibration.asset_conversion: .09 is provisional, inherited from v12; not upstream physical metadata.
proportion_calibration.next_architecture: Camera-local body/arms root and independent gun root; preserve source rig/rest/weights and no bone stretching.
proportion_calibration.acceptance: Ratios, shoulder/stock frame, full skin contacts, reach and camera cuts must pass together; no single ratio authorizes scaling.

fixed_shoulder_candidate.body: Mopt @ T(derived) @ Ry(-55deg) @ Rx(-90deg) @ S(.09) @ original_arm_world; body stays fixed camera-local.
fixed_shoulder_candidate.gun: Independent Mopt @ T(pivot+offset) @ Rxyz @ T(-pivot); only ADS is the accepted optical base.
fixed_shoulder_candidate.source_preservation: Bone hierarchy/rest, mesh/weights/UV/constraints preserved. Body/gun object parents and pose keys intentionally changed; original source files preserved.
fixed_shoulder_candidate.limits: Hip/reload placements rejected as offscreen. Full grip, motion, export, materials and runtime performance remain unapproved.
